name: FusedRopeWithQkNormAndKvCacheUpdate
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(query, key, value, position_ids, key_cache, value_cache, cache_position, q_norm_weight, k_norm_weight, inv_freq, rms_norm_eps=1e-6):
    q_normed = F.rms_norm(query.to(torch.float32), query.shape[-1:], q_norm_weight.to(torch.float32), rms_norm_eps).to(query.dtype)
    k_normed = F.rms_norm(key.to(torch.float32), key.shape[-1:], k_norm_weight.to(torch.float32), rms_norm_eps).to(key.dtype)
    batch_size, num_q_heads, seq_len, head_dim = query.shape
    inv_freq_expanded = inv_freq[None, None, :].expand(batch_size, seq_len, -1)
    position_ids_expanded = position_ids[:, :, None].float()
    freqs = position_ids_expanded * inv_freq_expanded
    emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)
    cos = emb.cos().unsqueeze(1).to(query.dtype)
    sin = emb.sin().unsqueeze(1).to(query.dtype)
    half = head_dim // 2
    q_rot = torch.cat((-q_normed[..., half:], q_normed[..., :half]), dim=-1)
    query_rotated = q_normed * cos + q_rot * sin
    k_rot = torch.cat((-k_normed[..., half:], k_normed[..., :half]), dim=-1)
    key_rotated = k_normed * cos + k_rot * sin
    key_cache_out = key_cache.clone()
    value_cache_out = value_cache.clone()
    # Use loop to match old forward's behavior for duplicate cache_position values.
    for i in range(seq_len):
        pos = int(cache_position[i].item())
        key_cache_out[:, :, pos, :] = key_rotated[:, :, i, :]
        value_cache_out[:, :, pos, :] = value[:, :, i, :]
    return query_rotated, key_rotated, key_cache_out, value_cache_out
description: Fused RoPE + QK normalization + KV cache update. Applies rotary position embedding, Q/K norm, and updates key/value cache. Pure PyTorch: RoPE computation + RMSNorm on Q/K + scatter into cache.
